# Design a Semantic Model

Use the supplied approved schema and requirements; do not connect to a live model unless separately authorized. Propose fact/dimension tables, keys, cardinality, relationship direction, date strategy, explicit measures, source mappings, RLS questions, refresh assumptions, and performance tradeoffs. For each measure document numerator, denominator, filters, exclusions, blank behavior, date context, owner, and acceptance examples. Include Power Query M/DAX only as reviewable proposals and provide tests and rollback.
